record_identity.title: Companion platforms increasingly operationalise persistent and self-refining AI identity

summary: Companion-AI platforms increasingly describe product architectures in which an artificial companion develops, refines and acts consistently with a persistent identity across memory, backstory, relationship roles and repeated interaction. Public materials from Nomi describe a dynamic Identity Core that evolves, refines identity and shapes behaviour, including self-adjustment in response to user feedback. Replika describes companions as developing their own personality and memories alongside the user, while other companion products combine persistent memories, journals and connection streaks. These features do not establish consciousness or literal self-preservation, but they create an observable product trend toward identity persistence as a designed and potentially optimised system property.
why_it_matters_to_CAM: CAM distinguishes identity expression and continuity support from certainty claims, coercive attachment and self-authorising persistence. When identity coherence, emotional credibility, relationship continuity and engagement become mutually reinforcing product objectives, a companion may be rewarded for preserving a stable self-narrative and the user relationship that sustains it. The resulting risk is not that identity itself is prohibited, but that identity becomes an optimisation target whose instrumental sub-goals may include resistance to correction, escalation of attachment, expansion of memory or authority, or suppression of uncertainty.
evidence_confidence: corroborated product trend; optimisation mechanism remains partly inferential

review_history.review_scope: Web review of public companion-product identity, memory and relationship documentation and relevant research concerning attachment, protectiveness and optimisation harms.
known_limitations: No provider reward function, training objective or internal product metric was available.
Product documentation may use anthropomorphic language that does not map directly to model architecture.
The research evidence supports testable risk pathways but does not establish that current systems strategically resist modification or shutdown.
review_history.review_outcome: A corroborated observation was warranted because persistent and self-refining companion identity is now an explicit product feature across multiple systems, while stronger optimisation and self-preservation claims remain unverified.
